purpose: Pinned inventory of third-party declaration diagnostics retained by the ADR-0002 exception. The accepted compiler gates skip checking inside declaration files; this file is what keeps the vendor defects visible. pnpm --filter @udg/server typecheck:probes:full reproduces it, and PR-0 compares the live inventory against this document and fails on any difference.

entries.message: Type 'UnionToIntersection<MethodOptions<API, "DELETE">> extends infer T ? { [K_1 in keyof T]: T[K_1]; } : never' does not satisfy the constraint '{ [K in keyof UnionToIntersection<MethodOptions<API, "DELETE">>]: UnionToIntersection<MethodOptions<API, "DELETE">>[K]; }'.

reviewRule: Any added file, added or changed diagnostic code, changed count or vanished entry must fail the probe suite. Clearing it requires a pin change plus an update to this document that says which release fixed which class. Deleting an entry because the accepted gates no longer print it is not a fix.
